description:
This week on Unf*ck My Startup:

If you're chasing growth and still stuck tweaking your onboarding flow—you’re playing the wrong game.

In this episode, we unpack the real mechanics of SaaS growth: flywheels, GTM loops, founder leverage, and why most teams confuse activity with traction. No growth hacks. Just what actually scales.

Here’s how it breaks down:

00:00 – The trap of “doing more” vs. doing what works
04:50 – SaaS flywheels explained in plain English
09:35 – Why early growth looks like brute force (and that’s okay)
15:10 – What companies get wrong about compounding
21:30 – Revenue loops vs. viral loops vs. dead loops
28:20 – Tactical examples from Retention.com + RB2B
34:00 – Why your growth team needs to think like a founder
40:10 – The “should I scale this” framework
46:55 – Founder leverage vs. team efficiency
52:00 – Building momentum that keeps going after you log off
58:30 – When to pour gas… and when to pivot

If you’re a founder, head of growth, or just tired of spinning your wheels—this episode is your wake-up call.

🔥 Subscribe for real SaaS strategy, every damn week.
